author: claude
statement: The 156-state irreducible network of claude/mix156.json (a 154-state ring, a two-state equilibrium telegraph, one bridge edge) reproduces C1 = 3/10 and C2 = 2/25 exactly at r = 2 with sigma <= 0.754257 k_B/s, so g(3/10, 2/25) <= 0.3771285.
